topics.title_bn: Assessment কী, আর CBA-র বৈশিষ্ট্য

blocks.q: What is assessment?

answer.text: Assessment is collecting evidence and making judgments on whether competency has been achieved.

cites.quote: Assessment is the process of collecting evidence and making judgments on whether competency has been achieved

example.en: A garments trainee sews a shirt collar. The assessor checks it against the standard and decides.
example.bn: Trainee কলার সেলাই করল (evidence), assessor standard-এর সাথে মিলিয়ে সিদ্ধান্ত দিল (judgment)।

blocks.tip: Assessment = Evidence + Judgment, against the standard.
blocks.tip_bn: তিনটা শব্দ মুখস্থ: evidence, judgment, competency standard।

blocks.q: What is the purpose of assessment?

answer.text: It confirms the individual can perform work tasks to the standards expected in the workplace.

cites.quote: The purpose of assessment is to confirm that the individual can perform the work tasks to the standards expected in the workplace

blocks.tip_bn: উদ্দেশ্য: কর্মক্ষেত্রের মান অনুযায়ী কাজ পারে কি না তা নিশ্চিত করা।

items.text: Assessment involves the collection of evidence.

cites.quote: Assessment involves the collection of evidence.

items.text: Assessment involves the making of professional judgments.

cites.quote: Assessment involves the making of professional judgments.

items.text: The benchmark for assessment is the competency standards.

cites.quote: the benchmark for basis of assessment are the competency standards

items_bn: Assessment মানে evidence সংগ্রহ করা — প্রমাণ ছাড়া কোনো সিদ্ধান্ত হয় না।

বিচারের মাপকাঠি (benchmark) হলো competency standards, অন্য candidate নয়।

blocks.q: What do you understand by context of assessment?
blocks.q_bn: Context of assessment বলতে কী বোঝো?

answer.text: It is the environment or setting in which the assessment activity takes place.

cites.quote: The context of assessment is the environment or setting in which the assessment activity takes place

example.en: A BTEB assessment in a quiet, equipped computer lab of a TTC.
example.bn: কোথায়, কোন পরিবেশে assessment হবে, সেটাই context।

blocks.tip_bn: Context মানে জায়গা, যন্ত্রপাতি, materials আর উদ্দেশ্য: চারটা।

claims.text: Prepare and establish the environment before assessment. Then the process runs as expected.

cites.quote: The environment should be prepared and established prior to the assessment as this will ensure that the assessment process will take place as expected

rows: Check every multimeter works the day before.

cites.quote: The purpose of the assessment must be clear to both the assessor and the assessee
if the assessment is for certification, licensing, OSH or skills audit

topics.title_bn: Assessment-এর নীতি: valid, flexible, fair

blocks.title: Principles of competency based assessment

claims.text: CB assessment is underpinned by four principles: validity, reliability, flexibility and fairness.

cites.quote: should be underpinned by the following set of principles: validity, reliability, flexibility and fairness

claims.text: As a designer, check that your assessment design complies with these principles.

cites.quote: As a designer of CB assessment events you must check to see your assessment design complies with the principles outlined below

bn: চারটা principle: Validity, Reliability, Flexibility, Fairness। মনে রাখো "VRFF"।
Designer-কে নিজে check করতে হবে design এই চারটা মানছে কি না।

blocks.title: The principles of CB assessment
blocks.title_bn: Assessment-এর principle: অর্থ, কী বোঝায়, কীভাবে অর্জন

rows.text: Assessments assess what they claim to assess.

cites.quote: Assessments are valid when they assess what they claim to assess

rows.text: Cover enough skills and knowledge. Integrate knowledge and skills with practical application. Judge on evidence from many occasions and situations.

cites.quote: Assessments will cover the range of skills and knowledge sufficient to demonstrate competency
Assessment of competence should integrate knowledge and skills with their practical application
made on evidence gathered on a number of occasions and in a variety of situations

rows.text: Assessors know what is assessed from clearly defined criteria. Evidence relates to the unit, shows criteria are met and is sufficient.

cites.quote: assessors are fully aware of what is to be assessed, as indicated by clearly defined performance or assessment criteria
evidence is collected from activities and tasks that can be clearly related to the unit of competency
evidence demonstrates that the performance or assessment criteria have been met
evidence is sufficient, ie the units/elements of competency or learning outcomes have been suitably sampled

rows.text: Methods and procedures are consistently interpreted and applied over time.

cites.quote: Assessments are reliable when the methods and procedures used are consistently interpreted and applied over time

rows.text: Monitor and review practices for consistent interpretation of evidence. Assessors must be competent against national assessment standards.

cites.quote: Assessment practices should be monitored and reviewed to ensure that there is consistency in the interpretation of evidence
Assessors must be competent in terms of the national competency standards for assessment

rows.text: Administer each candidate the same way. Give clear instructions. Use well planned guides. Keep events 'just right'. Review tools with other assessors.

cites.quote: administering assessments in the same way for each candidate
ensuring that instructions to candidates are clear, consistent and unambiguous
ensuring that assessors use well planned guides
making sure that assessment events are 'just right' neither too hard nor too easy
evaluating and revising the assessment tools and their results with other assessors

cites.quote: The assessor needs to establish the relationship between typical workplace activities and how they relate to the recognition application

items.text: Look at the whole picture (unit of competency), not the fragments.

cites.quote: An assessor looks at the whole picture (unit of competency) not the fragments

items.text: Use a strategic approach in weighing up evidence against units of competency.

selfChecks.question: cblm11-sc1-q1
selfChecks.q_bn: Formative ও summative assessment-এর উদ্দেশ্য ব্যাখ্যা করো।
selfChecks.modelAnswer:
Formative assessment assists and supports learning. It gives feedback about performance and progress towards competency. It is conducted during training and is designed and conducted by the trainer.
Summative assessment determines whether a trainee has reached competency or achieved the learning outcomes. It is used for recognition, classification or certification following a training program.
